description: This file defines the TatweejFragment class, a UI component for an Android app that displays a list of words with associated audio and handles user interactions for playing audio clips. It manages a RecyclerView with a custom adapter, handles debounce logic for taps, and interfaces with an audio player class.

classes.name: TatweejFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of words with audio playback functionality and manages the UI interactions and audio state.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView, adapter, and audio player; sets up click handling and UI updates.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops audio playback when the fragment is stopped.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Releases audio resources when the view is destroyed.
